metadata.title: Affine local-moment capacity
metadata.description: Retains the local fourth-moment proof's separate volume and capacity-defect allowances through its actual-source and physical transport wrappers. This replaces the narrower 22/5 capacity slice by an affine capacity and feeds a revised exact endpoint certificate into the all-Dirichlet continuation argument. Builds on nielstron's local 22/5 moment, Zhongpai Gao's local-moment work, Hailey Collet's Cycle25 framework, Akash Levy's weighted numerator, and OpenAI/math. Prepared with AI assistance.
